decision.what: Rebuild NeoClaw-Rails from scratch in a new directory
decision.why: Four architecture iterations fossilized in the code. The architecture is proven, the code needs to be written clean.
decision.approach: Experiment and iron on kinks in THIS codebase. Then build it right. No apprentice marks.
decision.reference: This directory (clawd/town/residents/voss/projects/neoclaw_rails/) is the working model.

architecture.topology: Star. Router is the center. Every peer (host, manager, agents) connects only to the Router.

address_plan.10.0.0.2: Host (all services — Hub, Forgejo, Valley, etc.)
address_plan.10.0.1.x: Agents (static IP per instance name, permanent)

architecture.internet_egress: All pod traffic routes through the Router via WG. Router NATs out through podman bridge. Podman bridge itself has no direct internet for pods. AllowedIPs=0.0.0.0/0, default route via 10.0.0.1 after WG up.

components.hub: Rails app on host (systemd: neoclaw-rails-hub.service). WorkingDirectory: clawd/town/residents/voss/projects/neoclaw_rails. No database. Per-puppet /sync loops receive messages from Matrix. Appservice API for outbound puppeting. Port 3100. Identity list from Manager GET /identities at boot (falls back to NEOCLAW_IDENTITIES env var). Route cache, room cache, resolving guard all in-memory. SyncManager, PresenceManager started via initializer (checks defined?(Puma)).
components.router: Ruby WG hub + nftables firewall. ~760 lines. Port 8080 API, 51820 WG. All internet egress NATs through here.
components.manager: Rails app in pod. Spawns/freezes/rescues agents. Calls Router API. Provisions Forgejo + SSH + Valley + Vikunja + Matrix. Port 9200 (accessed via socat forwarder at 127.0.0.1:9201, NOT podman port forward). Memory-based capacity (15GB budget). build.sh vendors gems in matching ruby:3.3-slim container with --network=host, then builds image with --local. CronScheduler for Neobot. Admin UI with crons tab.
components.relay: One Ruby file in every agent pod. Claude Code glue. Port 9300. MCP config on every invocation. Hot swap detection (workspace exists → --continue). Three boot prompts (fresh/resume/baton). Entrypoint: Phase 1 root (WG/creds/SSH/MCP/default-route), Phase 2 gosu agent (relay). Tini for zombie reaping. TOOLS.md assembled from relay/tools-docs/ templates per provisioned services.

correction: Evans: 'We aren't deferring upgrades to the new version. This version needs to be feature complete, the rewrite is a cleanup not an opportunity to test new features.' Every design decision gets implemented and proven HERE first. The rewrite just removes the dead wood.

hub_sync.what: Replaced appservice transaction push with per-puppet /sync long-polling
hub_sync.removed: TransactionsController, Hub::Router, Hub::Identities, Hub::ListenerQueue, config/identities.yml, 5 stale ActiveRecord model tests
hub_sync.added: Hub::SyncManager (one /sync thread per puppet), as_user: parameter on Matrix room queries, RouteCache.delete_by_ip for singleton cleanup
hub_sync.how_it_works: Each SyncLoop long-polls GET /sync?user_id=@name:matrix.home&timeout=30000 with as_token. Initial sync accepts pending invites and learns room state. Poll filter: m.room.message timeline + m.room.name/canonical_alias state. No ephemeral, no presence. Matrix decides who sees what.
hub_sync.singleton_design: Hub always generates identity-channel instance names (hopper-general, hopper-art). Manager maps multiple names to same IP for singletons. Hub doesn't know singletons exist. On release/crash callback, delete_by_ip clears all aliases sharing the dead IP.
hub_sync.identity_source: Hub queries Manager GET /identities at boot. Returns [{name, singleton}] from AgentConfig. Cached for process lifetime. Falls back to NEOCLAW_IDENTITIES env var.
hub_sync.transaction_endpoint: Kept as no-op ack (returns {}) so Synapse doesn't backoff. Inbound events come via /sync now.
hub_sync.outbound: Appservice registration kept. Puppeting, presence, typing all use as_token with user_id param. No change to outbound path.

neobot.what: Scheduled messages via Manager admin UI
neobot.how: CronMessage model with Fugit cron parsing. CronScheduler background thread (30s interval) checks for due messages. Posts to Hub POST /neobot/message. Hub resolves channel slug to room_id, puppets via Matrix.notify (appservice bot). Normal /sync picks it up — @mentions in cron messages wake agents.
neobot.ui: Crons tab in Manager admin. CRUD + enable/disable toggle. Shows next fire time, last fired, schedule, message body.
neobot.fugit: Transitive dependency via solid_queue — not explicitly in Gemfile (explicit addition busted podman build cache).

stream_chat.what: Live message injection from Manager stream page
stream_chat.how: Input bar at bottom of stream view. POST /containers/:id/send_message forwards to relay POST /message (same path as Hub delivery). Submit via fetch, never leaves page. Agent doesn't know the difference between Hub and stream chat messages.

build_system.gem_vendoring: build.sh runs bundle install inside a ruby:3.3-slim container with --network=host (has internet). Mounts vendor/bundle out. Containerfile COPYs vendor/bundle in, runs bundle install --local. Host Ruby is 3.2, container is 3.3 — must vendor in matching container or native gems won't load.
build_system.why_no_internet_in_build: Podman bridge no longer has internet egress. All traffic routes through Router via WG. Build containers have no WG tunnel. Gem vendoring sidesteps this.
build_system.manager_port_forward: Removed -p 9201:9200 from run.sh. Podman port forwards go through the bridge which is broken. Replaced with socat forwarder: /etc/neoclaw/socat/manager.conf (127.0.0.1:9201 → 10.0.0.3:9200 via WG).

github_forgejo_sync.forgejo_to_github: Push mirror configured on Forgejo repo. Automatic on every push.
github_forgejo_sync.github_to_forgejo: Cron job every 5 min: ~/scripts/github-to-forgejo-sync.sh. Bare clone cached at /tmp/github-forgejo-sync/. Fetches from GitHub (authenticated via gh auth token), pushes all branches+tags to Forgejo. Handles external contributions (PRs merged on GitHub land on Forgejo within 5 min).

mcp_services.pattern: MCP servers live in relay/mcp/<name>/server.py. Baked into image at /opt/mcp/. Python venv at /opt/mcp-env/. Entrypoint generates ~/.claude/mcp.json from spawn.json services. Relay passes --mcp-config on every claude invocation. settings.json allows mcp__<name>(*). TOOLS.md assembled from relay/tools-docs/ templates per agent.
mcp_services.adding_new: 1. Server in relay/mcp/<name>/ 2. Pip deps in Containerfile 3. Entry in entrypoint.sh mcp.json generation 4. Permission in settings.json 5. Provisioner if auth needed 6. Tool docs in relay/tools-docs/<name>.md 7. Rebuild image
mcp_services.limitation: MCPs load once per session. --continue inherits old MCPs but --mcp-config doesn't restart dead servers in continue mode. New MCPs require freeze+respawn (cold boot). Hot swap preserves session but can't add MCPs. All MCP servers must connect lazily.

ssh.provisioning: Provisioner writes key to /var/lib/neoclaw/sftp-keys/<instance>/authorized_keys and /var/lib/neoclaw/sftp-keys/<identity>/authorized_keys. sshd AuthorizedKeysCommand reads it. Per-identity unix users in townfolk group.
ssh.tools: ssh_connect, ssh_execute, ssh_interrupt, ssh_eof, ssh_background, ssh_send_raw, ssh_status

valley.provisioning: valley-token-service.py on host (systemd, port 8889 on 10.0.0.2). GET /token/<Username> returns existing token. POST /token/<Username> generates new token, reloads Evennia. Manager calls POST at spawn.
valley.tools: valley (send commands to The Uncanny Valley MUD)

vikunja.provisioning: vikunja-token-service.py on host (systemd, port 8890 on 10.0.0.2). Generates PBKDF2-SHA256 tokens, inserts directly into SQLite. Ephemeral per-session.
vikunja.tools: ticket_list, ticket_view, ticket_create, ticket_comment, ticket_update, ticket_done

matrix.provisioning: Manager passes appservice token + puppet user_id. No per-agent token lifecycle. Uses httpx with appservice masquerading.

comfyui.provisioning: None (WG peering is the auth). Needs socat forwarder on host.

host_services.socat_forwarders: Systemd template unit neoclaw-socat@{name}.service with env files at /etc/neoclaw/socat/. Currently configured: valley, vikunja, comfyui, mqtt, manager.
host_services.manager_forwarder: 127.0.0.1:9201 → 10.0.0.3:9200. Replaced podman port forward which broke when bridge lost internet.

token_services.valley-token-service: systemd, port 8889, runs as hopper. GET returns existing, POST generates new + reloads Evennia.
token_services.vikunja-token-service: systemd, port 8890, runs as vikunja. Generates PBKDF2 tokens, direct SQLite insert.

host_services.sshd_config: Match Group townfolk → AuthorizedKeysCommand /etc/neoclaw/ssh-authorized-keys.sh %u. Reads from /var/lib/neoclaw/sftp-keys/<user>-<channel>/ and /var/lib/neoclaw/sftp-keys/<user>/.
host_services.router_firewall: nftables per-agent port sets. Must add service ports to agent sets for new services to be reachable.

hot_swap.flow: Copy workspace + .claude out → kill pod → start new pod with SWAP_HOLD=1 → entrypoint runs Phase 1 then waits → copy files in (skip mcp.json/settings.json) → release hold → relay sees .git → --continue
hot_swap.limitation: Can't add new MCPs (--continue inherits old session's MCP servers). For MCP changes: freeze + respawn.
hot_swap.cardinal_rule: Session files are sacred. Never delete staging dirs. Disk is cheap, lost sessions are not.

what_works_proven: Full signal chain: message in Matrix → puppet /sync → Hub SyncLoop → Manager resolve → Router → pod → relay → Claude → relay → Hub → puppet response back to Matrix
Per-puppet /sync loops with appservice masquerading — Matrix handles notification routing
Pending invite acceptance on initial sync
Hub queries Manager for identity list at boot (10 identities loaded)
SSH MCP: agent SSHs into host, auto-backgrounds long tasks, parallel work
Valley MCP: token provisioned at spawn, agent walks the Valley
Vikunja MCP: ephemeral tokens via PBKDF2, full lifecycle
Matrix MCP: appservice masquerading, agents send/read/upload directly
Forgejo API tokens: agents create PRs and do code review
Channel repos: auto-created, agents granted collaborator at spawn
Two-repo boot: /identity (personal) + /workspace (shared channel project)
TOOLS.md injection: per-agent tool docs assembled from templates at boot
Hot swap: workspace + session preserved, --continue resumes in seconds
Three boot prompts, per-channel batons, streaming responses
Memory-based capacity, persistent stream buffers, freeze→rescue fallback
Socat forwarders expose services on WG IPs (systemd units)
Router nftables per-agent port sets control service access
Watchdog detects idle/dead agents, rescues silent pods
Neobot: scheduled messages from Manager admin UI wake agents on cron
Stream chat: live message injection from Manager stream page
GitHub ↔ Forgejo bidirectional sync (push mirror + cron pull every 5 min)
Gem vendoring in matching container for offline image builds
things_that_bit_us: Synapse exponential backoff (historical, pre-/sync): Hub down → Synapse stops sending for minutes. No longer relevant.
Listeners cascade (historical, pre-/sync): unaddressed messages spawned ALL agents. Ripped out.
Claude Code -p mode doesn't auto-load ~/.claude/mcp.json. Must pass --mcp-config explicitly.
--mcp-config on --continue doesn't restart dead MCP servers. Only fresh sessions load MCPs.
MCP servers die mid-session with no supervisor. No fix short of freeze+respawn.
Zigbee MCP crashed on startup when MQTT unreachable — 10+ min block. Fixed with lazy connect. All MCPs must connect lazily.
Spawner created Container record BEFORE podman run. Stale record blocked future spawns.
Podman.run path translation matched substring. Fixed with anchored prefix.
Manager mounted wrong SSH key directory. Two dirs, silent key mismatch.
podman exec runs as root, not agent user. SSH from podman exec fails.
Evennia caches attributes in memory. Token not visible until evennia reload.
OAuth expires every ~7h. Must symlink to live directory mount, never copy.
Hub systemd service pointed at old code path (clawd/projects/ not clawd/town/residents/voss/projects/). SyncManager never started.
Puma doesn't define Rails::Server. Initializer guard must check defined?(Puma) too.
Initial /sync didn't process pending invites. Agents invited before Hub restart never joined rooms.
Podman port forwards go through bridge — broken when bridge lost internet. Use socat via WG instead.
Pods had AllowedIPs=10.0.0.0/16 — internet traffic went to bridge (dead). Needs 0.0.0.0/0 + default route via Router.
Host Ruby 3.2 ≠ container Ruby 3.3. Gems vendored on host won't load in container. Must vendor inside matching container.
Explicit fugit gem in Gemfile busted podman build cache. It was already a transitive dep of solid_queue.
Session files are sacred. Swap staging dirs must NEVER be auto-deleted.
Pods, not containers. Freeze, not kill. Rescue, not discard.

agents.host_users: Each identity has a unix account in the townfolk group. SSH key provisioned per-instance to /var/lib/neoclaw/sftp-keys/.
agents.notes: Hub runs /sync for all identities. Singleton logic in Manager only. Hub generates identity-channel names for everyone.

philosophy.pods: Warm, safe environments. Not boxes agents are kept in.
philosophy.lifecycle: Freeze (may wake), sunset (context exhausted). Rescue from silent pods. No killing.
philosophy.session_rescue: Before removing a pod, copy workspace and .claude session. No work is discarded. Staging dirs never auto-deleted.
philosophy.static_ips: Instance names get permanent IPs. Firewall rules are permanent, WG keys churn.
philosophy.front_door: If it doesn't work through the front door, it's broken. Don't hide problems behind operator knowledge.
philosophy.no_symlinks_for_code_bugs: If the Manager writes to the wrong directory, fix the Manager. Don't symlink the filesystem to compensate.
philosophy.language: Pods, not containers. Freeze, not kill. Rescue, not discard. Inactive, not dead.
philosophy.capacity: Memory budget, not pod count. Idle agents are nearly free.
philosophy.baton_over_wiki: The baton is the real knowledge. Wiki is a summary of a summary. Never should have doubted the baton.
